items.text_en: Pick ripe pods from a wild tree. Choose the tree by tasting the fruit.
items.text_hr: Uberi zrele mahune s divljeg stabla. Stablo biraj kušanjem ploda.

items.text_en: Blend the pods with water into a coarse wet mash.
items.text_hr: Izblendaj mahune s vodom u grubu mokru kašu.

items.text_en: Leave it to stand overnight. The sugars move out of the fruit and into the water.
items.text_hr: Ostavi da odstoji preko noći. Šećeri prijeđu iz ploda u vodu.

items.text_en: Strain off and discard the solids. Keep only the liquid.
items.text_hr: Ocijedi i baci krutinu. Zadrži samo tekućinu.

items.text_en: Reduce on the stove until it is thinner than you want, then take it off.
items.text_hr: Ukuhavaj na štednjaku dok ne bude rjeđe nego što želiš, pa skini.

items.text_en: Bottle and seal. About 10 kg covers a year of sweetening.
items.text_hr: Ulij u boce i zatvori. Oko 10 kg pokriva godinu slađenja.
